meta.title: About us
meta.description: dristro imports and distributes high-quality international beverages for the German B2B market. Learn about our mission and our team.

About.title: International beverage import with a personal touch
intro: dristro was founded with the goal of making selected, high-quality beverages and snacks from international markets accessible to German retailers. Rather than relying on large, impersonal distribution structures, we work closely with manufacturers and trading partners – with short decision-making paths and a clear focus on quality.

Our portfolio spans several product categories – from energy drinks to iced tea to coconut water – instead of limiting ourselves to a single product. This allows us to offer retail, hospitality and wholesale businesses a varied, in-demand range from a single source. More brands and categories will follow as they meet our quality standards.
About.founderText: Hamzah Hajji founded dristro to build a reliable bridge between international beverage manufacturers and German retail. At its core is direct, personal contact with every partner – from the first conversation to ongoing collaboration.
